title: phase-plan execution file
source_task: Eliminate UI freezes during streaming, typing, project switching, Save-As, resize, and file persistence.
ordering_rationale: First isolate hot-path projection and I/O, then make resize/project transitions latest-value-wins, then run cross-cutting review and host/runtime verification.

completed.evidence: Cross-angle review completed with rust-audit/slint guidance and two subagents: no lock-across-await remains in touched async paths; stream-close flush and persistence ordering were fixed/verified; no Slint source was edited, and retained-model updates are keyed/no-op aware.

Reviewed each completed phase against the plan and source diff; no false-positive completion found. Remaining Save-As, resize, Markdown worker, chat windowing, and runtime UI phases remain explicitly pending.
No implementation misalignments remained after the review patch; stream-close visual flush was added and cargo check/tests rerun.

Event forwarder retains every ordered AgentEvent::Message and persists each one, while coalescing transcript refreshes into bursts of four; semantic events flush pending visual state before handling. cargo check --lib passed.

thread_view::tests (9 passed); bounded nested-row and outer-slot updates skip unchanged rows while changed rows propagate. Review fixes include outer group-key identity, deterministic duplicate-group suffixing to prevent VecModel aliasing, duplicate message-key first-row retention, and all Slint-visible queued/send/first-use/grouping fields in the row fingerprint.

jsonl_append_offload_tests::offloaded_append_preserves_serial_order passed; live and replay AgentEvent::Message appends use spawn_blocking with sequential awaits. push_local/runtime snapshot writes remain synchronous by API/design.
